glosses: to walk in, to enter by walking

examples.text: Ze zijn de verkeerde kamer ingelopen
examples.translation: They walked into the wrong room
examples.english: They walked into the wrong room

glosses: to catch up (to reach something that had been ahead)

examples.text: Door harder te fietsen, kon ik de groep wielrenners voor mij inlopen
examples.translation: By cycling faster, I was able to catch up with the group of cyclists ahead of me
examples.english: By cycling faster, I was able to catch up with the group of cyclists ahead of me

glosses: to make up for lost time, to catch up on something that one has missed or neglected

examples.text: Ik moet wat extra uren werken om mijn achterstand in te lopen
examples.translation: I have to work some extra hours to catch up on my backlog
examples.english: I have to work some extra hours to catch up on my backlog

glosses: to wear in or break in something new, to make it more comfortable to wear or use

examples.text: Mijn nieuwe schoenen zaten heel strak, maar na een paar dagen inlopen zaten ze veel beter
examples.translation: My new shoes were very tight, but after wearing them in for a few days, they felt much better
examples.english: My new shoes were very tight, but after wearing them in for a few days, they felt much better

forms.form:
te zullen inlopen
in te zullen lopen

examples.text: Zij waren de verkeerde kamer ingelopen.
